# dmfun

**dmfun** provides miscellaneous functions, mostly for helping with R
package development. Generally, the functions are meant to be used
interactively as you’re developing a package.

## Installation

You can install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("dmuenz/dmfun")
```

## Functions

Here’s a brief description of all **dmfun**’s functions.

- [`build_and_preview_article()`](https://dmuenz.github.io/dmfun/reference/build_and_preview_article.md):
  When writing an article or vignette for your **pkgdown** site, you may
  want to quickly build and preview it. This function does both of those
  things! By default it works with the active file in your IDE, so you
  don’t need to pass any arguments.

- [`debug_print()`](https://dmuenz.github.io/dmfun/reference/debug_print.md):
  When debugging a function, debugging tools built into an IDE can be
  great, but sometimes you just want to print an object that’s causing
  problems. Instead of using
  [`print()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/print.html), try using
  [`debug_print()`](https://dmuenz.github.io/dmfun/reference/debug_print.md):
  it will print to the console the expression that you pass to it, along
  with the parent function name and the output of the expression. So it
  gives you more context than just using
  [`print()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/print.html).

- [`gtable_print()`](https://dmuenz.github.io/dmfun/reference/gtable_print.md):
  Prints a **gtable** object in an easier-to-read format compared to the
  default gtable print method. There are also extra options for
  conveniently subsetting the printed gtable.

- [`gtable_show_grobs()`](https://dmuenz.github.io/dmfun/reference/gtable_show_grobs.md):
  Draws a **gtable**, labeling and putting a border around every
  non-zero grob.

- [`lint_package_to_md()`](https://dmuenz.github.io/dmfun/reference/lint_package_to_md.md):
  Lints a package using
  [`lintr::lint_package()`](https://lintr.r-lib.org/reference/lint.html)
  and writes the findings to a Markdown file.

- `print_tbl`: Prints a **tibble** with optional control over the column
  type row, row IDs, and tibble header. Apart from these display
  options, normal tibble printing behavior is preserved.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`build_and_preview_article()`](https://dmuenz.github.io/dmfun/reference/build_and_preview_article.md)
  : Build and preview an article for a pkgdown website
- [`debug_print()`](https://dmuenz.github.io/dmfun/reference/debug_print.md)
  : Print an object for debugging
- [`gtable_print()`](https://dmuenz.github.io/dmfun/reference/gtable_print.md)
  : Print a gtable object as a tibble
- [`gtable_show_grobs()`](https://dmuenz.github.io/dmfun/reference/gtable_show_grobs.md)
  : Draw a gtable, labeling and putting a border around every non-zero
  grob
- [`lint_package_to_md()`](https://dmuenz.github.io/dmfun/reference/lint_package_to_md.md)
  : Lint a package and write findings to Markdown
- [`lint_simplify()`](https://dmuenz.github.io/dmfun/reference/lint_simplify.md)
  : Simplify a lintr object for easy printing
- [`print_tbl()`](https://dmuenz.github.io/dmfun/reference/print_tbl.md)
  : Print a tibble with additional display options
